newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan cell phone users seen hitting 45 mln by 2000.
newsitem.headline: Japan cell phone users seen hitting 45 mln by 2000.

text.p: The estimated number of cellular phone users in Japan by the end of the year 2000 has been revised up to 45 million from a forecast of 28 million made in April, the Posts and Telecommunications Ministry said on Monday.
"The installation of new digital CDMA technology, which allows more efficient use of radio frequencies, will enable a bigger increase in the number of subscribers," a ministry official said.
The ministry expects the number of subscribers to reach 63 million by 2010, the official said.
CDMA, or cord division multiple access, is a digital cell phone standard developed in the United States.
